verses.en: Now these are the children of the province that went up out of the captivity, of those which had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away unto Babylon, and came again unto Jerusalem and Judah, every one unto his city;
verses.sm: Ierusalema O i latou nei o tagata o le itu malo na o ae nai le tafeaga, o le tafeaga lea na avea i Papelonia e Nepukanesa le tupu o Papelonia, na latou toe foi mai foi i Ierusalema ma Iuta, taitasi le tagata ma lana aai;

verses.en: Which came with Zerubbabel: Jeshua, Nehemiah, Seraiah, Reelaiah, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispar, Bigvai, Rehum, Baanah. The number of the men of the people of Israel:
verses.sm: o e na o mai faatasi ma Serupapelu; o Iosua, o Neemia, o Seraia, o Reelaia, o Moretekai, o Pilesana, o Mesepara, o Pikevai, o Rekuma, o Paana. O le faitau aofai o tagata o le nuu o Isaraelu;

verses.en: The children of Parosh, two thousand an hundred seventy and two.
verses.sm: o le fanauga a Parose, e lua afe e toaselau e toafitugafulu ma le toalua.

verses.en: The children of Shephatiah, three hundred seventy and two.
verses.sm: O le fanauga a Sefatia, e toatolu selau e toafitugafulu ma le toalua.

verses.en: The children of Arah, seven hundred seventy and five.
verses.sm: O le fanauga a Araka, e toafitugalau ma le toafitugafulu ma le toalima.

verses.en: The children of Pahath-moab, of the children of Jeshua and Joab, two thousand eight hundred and twelve.
verses.sm: O le fanauga a Pakamoapi, o le fanauga ia a lesua ma loapo, e lua afe e valu selau e toatinoagafulu ma le toalua.

verses.en: The children of Elam, a thousand two hundred fifty and four.
verses.sm: O le fanauga a Elama, e toaafe e toalua lau e toalimagafulu ma le toafa.

verses.en: The children of Zattu, nine hundred forty and five.
verses.sm: O le fanauga a Satu, e iva selau e toafagafulu ma le toalima.

verses.en: The children of Zaccai, seven hundred and threescore.
verses.sm: O le fanauga a Sakai, e fitu selau ma le toaonogafulu.

verses.en: The children of Bani, six hundred forty and two.
verses.sm: O le fanauga a Pani, e ono selau e toafagafulu ma le toalua.

verses.en: The children of Bebai, six hundred twenty and three.
verses.sm: O le fanauga a Pepai, e ono selau e toaluafulu ma le toatolu.

verses.en: The children of Azgad, a thousand two hundred twenty and two.
verses.sm: O le fanauga a Asekata, e toaafe e toalua lau e toaluafulu ma le toalua.

verses.en: The children of Adonikam, six hundred sixty and six.
verses.sm: O le fanauga a Atonikama, e ono selau e toaonogafulu ma le toaono.

verses.en: The children of Bigvai, two thousand fifty and six.
verses.sm: O le fanauga a Pikevai, e lua afe e toalimagafulu ma le toaono.

verses.en: The children of Adin, four hundred fifty and four.
verses.sm: O le fanauga a Atini, e fa selau e toalimagafulu ma le toafa.

verses.en: The children of Ater of Hezekiah, ninety and eight.
verses.sm: O le fanauga a Atere mai ia Esekia, e toaivagafulu ma le toavalu.

verses.en: The children of Bezai, three hundred twenty and three.
verses.sm: O le fanauga a Pesai, e tolu selau e toaluafulu ma le toatolu.

verses.en: The children of Jorah, an hundred and twelve.
verses.sm: O le fanauga a lora, e toaselau e toatinoagafulu ma le toalua.

verses.en: The children of Hashum, two hundred twenty and three.
verses.sm: O le fanauga a Hasumu, e toalua lau e toaluafulu ma le toatolu.

verses.en: The children of Gibbar, ninety and five.
verses.sm: O le fanauga a Kipara, e toaivagafulu ma le toalima.

verses.en: The children of Beth-lehem, an hundred twenty and three.
verses.sm: O tagata O Peteleema, e toaselau e toaluafulu ma le toatolu.

verses.en: The men of Netophah, fifty and six.
verses.sm: O tagata O Netopa, e toalimagafulu ma le toaono.

verses.en: The men of Anathoth, an hundred twenty and eight.
verses.sm: O tagata o Anatota, E toaselau e toaluafulu ma le toavalu.

verses.en: The children of Azmaveth, forty and two.
verses.sm: O le fanauga a Asemau, e toafagafulu ma le toalua.

verses.en: The children of Kirjath-arim, Chephirah, and Beeroth, seven hundred and forty and three.
verses.sm: O tagata o Kiriata-arima, o Kafira, ma Perota, e fitu selau ma le toafagafulu ma le toatolu.

verses.en: The children of Ramah and Gaba, six hundred twenty and one.
verses.sm: O tagata o Rama ma Kipea, e toaono selau e toaluafulu ma le toatasi.

verses.en: The men of Michmas, an hundred twenty and two.
verses.sm: O tagata o Mekemase, e toaselau e toaluafulu ma le toalua.

verses.en: The men of Beth-el and Ai, two hundred twenty and three.
verses.sm: O tagata o Peteli ma Ai, e toalua lau e toaluafulu ma le toatolu.

verses.en: The children of Nebo, fifty and two.
verses.sm: O tagata o Nepo, e toalimagafulu ma le toalua.

verses.en: The children of Magbish, an hundred fifty and six.
verses.sm: O tagata o Magapise, e toaselau e toalimagafulu ma le toaono.

verses.en: The children of the other Elam, a thousand two hundred fifty and four.
verses.sm: O le fanauga a le isi Elama, e toaafe e toalua lau e toalimagafulu ma le toafa,

verses.en: The children of Harim, three hundred and twenty.
verses.sm: O le fanauga a Harima, e tolu selau ma le toaluafulu.

verses.en: The children of Lod, Hadid, and Ono, seven hundred twenty and five.
verses.sm: O tagata o Loto, ma Hatito, ma Ono, e fitu selau e toaluafulu ma le toalima.

verses.en: The children of Jericho, three hundred forty and five.
verses.sm: O tagata o leriko, e tolu selau e fa sefulu ma le toalima.

verses.en: The children of Senaah, three thousand and six hundred and thirty.
verses.sm: O tagata o Senaa, e tolu o afe ma le toaono galau ma le toatolugafulu.

verses.en: The priests: the children of Jedaiah, of the house of Jeshua, nine hundred seventy and three.
verses.sm: O le au faitaulaga; o le fanauga a letaia, o le aiga o lesua, e iva selau e toafitugafulu ma le toatolu.

verses.en: The children of Immer, a thousand fifty and two.
verses.sm: O le fanauga a Imere, e toaafe e toalimagafulu ma le toalua.

verses.en: The children of Pashur, a thousand two hundred forty and seven.
verses.sm: O le fanauga a Pasura, e toaafe e toalua lau e toafagafulu ma le toafitu.

verses.en: The children of Harim, a thousand and seventeen.
verses.sm: O le fanauga a Harima, e toaafe e toasefulu ma le toafitu.

verses.en: The Levites: the children of Jeshua and Kadmiel, of the children of Hodaviah, seventy and four.
verses.sm: O sa Levi; o le fanauga a lesua ma Katameeli, o le fanauga ia a Hotavia, e toafitugafulu ma le toafa.

verses.en: The singers: the children of Asaph, an hundred twenty and eight.
verses.sm: O le au pepese; o le fanauga a Asafo, e toaselau e toaluafulu ma le toavalu.

verses.en: The children of the porters: the children of Shallum, the children of Ater, the children of Talmon, the children of Akkub, the children of Hatita, the children of Shobai, in all an hundred thirty and nine.
verses.sm: O le fanauga a le au leoleo faitotoa; o le fanauga a Saluma, o le fanauga a Atere, o le fanauga a Talemoni, o le fanauga a Akupa, o le fanauga a Hatita, o le fanauga a Sopai, o i latou uma e toaselau e toatolugafulu ma le toaiva.

verses.en: The Nethinims: the children of Ziha, the children of Hasupha, the children of Tabbaoth,
verses.sm: O le au netini; o le fanauga a Seka, o le fanauga a Hasufi, o le fanauga a Tapaota,

verses.en: The children of Keros, the children of Siaha, the children of Padon,
verses.sm: 0 le fanauga a Kirosa, o le fanauga a Seaa, o le fanauga a Patono,

verses.en: The children of Lebanah, the children of Hagabah, the children of Akkub,
verses.sm: o le fanauga a Lepana, o le fanauga a Hakepa, o le fanauga a Akupa,

verses.en: The children of Hagab, the children of Shalmai, the children of Hanan,
verses.sm: o le fanauga a Hakapa, o le fanauga a Salemai, o le fanauga a Hanana,

verses.en: The children of Giddel, the children of Gahar, the children of Reaiah,
verses.sm: o le fanauga a Kitele, o le fanauga a Gakara, o le fanauga a Reaia,

verses.en: The children of Rezin, the children of Nekoda, the children of Gazzam,
verses.sm: o le fanauga a Resina, o le fanauga a Nekota, o le fanauga a Gasama,

verses.en: The children of Uzza, the children of Paseah, the children of Besai,
verses.sm: 0 le fanauga a Usa, o le fanauga a Pasea, o le fanauga a Pesai,

verses.en: The children of Asnah, the children of Mehunim, the children of Nephusim,
verses.sm: o le fanauga a Asena, o le fanauga a Meunima, o le fanauga a Nefasemo,

verses.en: The children of Bakbuk, the children of Hakupha, the children of Harhur,
verses.sm: 0 le fanauga a Pakepuka, o le fanauga a Hakupa, o le fanauga a Harekuru,

verses.en: The children of Bazluth, the children of Mehida, the children of Harsha,
verses.sm: o le fanauga a Paseluta, o le fanauga a Mekita, o le fanauga a Haresa,

verses.en: The children of Barkos, the children of Sisera, the children of Thamah,
verses.sm: o le fanauga a Parekusa, o le fanauga a Sesera, o le fanauga a Timaka,

verses.en: The children of Neziah, the children of Hatipha.
verses.sm: o le fanauga a Neseka, o le fanauga a Hatifa.

verses.en: The children of Solomon's servants: the children of Sotai, the children of Sophereth, the children of Peruda,
verses.sm: O le fanauga a auauna a Solomona; o le fanauga a Sotai, o le fanauga o Soferete, o le fanauga a Feruta,

verses.en: The children of Jaalah, the children of Darkon, the children of Giddel,
verses.sm: o le fanauga a laala, o le fanauga a Tarekono, o le fanauga a Kitele,

verses.en: The children of Shephatiah, the children of Hattil, the children of Pochereth of Zebaim, the children of Ami.
verses.sm: o le fanauga a Sefatia, o le fanauga a Hatili, o le fanauga a Pokerete o le Sepaima, o le fanauga a Ame.

verses.en: All the Nethinims, and the children of Solomon's servants, were three hundred ninety and two.
verses.sm: O le au netini uma, ma le fanauga a auauna a Solomona, e tolu selau e toaivagafulu ma le toalua.

verses.en: And these were they which went up from Tel-melah, Tel-harsa, Cherub, Addan, and Immer: but they could not shew their father's house, and their seed, whether they were of Israel:
verses.sm: O i latou nei foi e na o ae ai Tele-melaka, ma Tele-aresa, ma Kirova, ma Atana, ma Imere; a ua le mafaia e i latou ona faaalia mai le aiga o latou tama, ma lo latou tupuga, pe ni Isaraelu i latou;

verses.en: The children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda, six hundred fifty and two.
verses.sm: o le fanauga a Talaia, o le fanauga a Tovia, o le fanauga a Nekota, e ono selau e toalimagafulu ma le toalua.

verses.en: And of the children of the priests: the children of Habaiah, the children of Koz, the children of Barzillai; which took a wife of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite, and was called after their name:
verses.sm: O isi fanauga foi a le au faitaulaga; o le fanauga a Hapaia, o le fanauga a Kosa, o le fanauga a Pasili o le na fai avá i le afafine o Pasili le Kiliata, sa igoa foi o ia i lo latou igoa;

verses.en: These sought their register among those that were reckoned by genealogy, but they were not found: therefore were they, as polluted, put from the priesthood.
verses.sm: o i latou ia na latou sailiili i lo latou tusiga i e na tusia o latou tupuga, a e lei maua; sa taʻua ai i latou ua leaga, ua tea ai ma le faiva o faitaulaga.

verses.en: And the Tirshatha said unto them, that they should not eat of the most holy things, till there stood up a priest with Urim and with Thummim.
verses.sm: Na fai atu foi ia te i latou le alii e pule, aua neʻi aai i latou i mea e sili ona paia, seia tu mai se faitaulaga ma le Urima ma le Tumema.

verses.en: The whole congregation together was forty and two thousand three hundred and threescore,
verses.sm: O le aofai o le faapotopotoga uma, e fa sefulu o afe ma afe e lua ma le tolu selau ma le toaonogafulu;

verses.en: Beside their servants and their maids, of whom there were seven thousand three hundred thirty and seven: and there were among them two hundred singing men and singing women.
verses.sm: a o a latou auauna tane ma a latou auauna fafine, o i latou ia e fitu afe e tolu selau e toatolugafulu ma le toafitu; sa ia te i latou foi o tane pepese ma fafine pepese e toalua selau.

verses.en: Their horses were seven hundred thirty and six; their mules, two hundred forty and five;
verses.sm: O a latou solofanua e fitu selau e tolugafulu ma le ono; o a latou falata e lua selau e fagafulu ma le lima;

verses.en: Their camels, four hundred thirty and five; their asses, six thousand seven hundred and twenty.
verses.sm: o a latou kamela e fa selau e tolugafulu ma le lima; o a latou asini e ono afe e fitu selau ma le luafulu.

verses.en: And some of the chief of the fathers, when they came to the house of the LORD which is at Jerusalem, offered freely for the house of God to set it up in his place:
verses.sm: O isi foi o matai sili, ua latou oo mai i le fale o le ALII o i Ierusalema, ona fai taulaga lea ma le loto mo le fale o le Atua ina ia faatuina ai i lona tulafale.

verses.en: They gave after their ability unto the treasure of the work threescore and one thousand drams of gold, and five thousand pound of silver, and one hundred priests' garments.
verses.sm: Ua latou foai e tusa ma a latou mea i le oloa mo le galuega, o auro e ono sefulu o afe ma le afe e tasi o tareki; ma ario e lima afe o mina; ma ofu tino o faitaulaga e selau.

verses.en: So the priests, and the Levites, and some of the people, and the singers, and the porters, and the Nethinims, dwelt in their cities, and all Israel in their cities.
verses.sm: Sa nonofo foi le au faitaulaga, ma sa Levi, ma isi o le nuu, ma le au pepese, ma le au leoleo faitotoa, ma le au netini, i a latou aai, ma Isaraelu uma i a latou aai.
